Confirmed in `guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java`: `Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` (line ~2542) adds the entry to the lock-free `recencyQueue` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue`), and later `Segment.drainRecencyQueue()` (line ~2590), called under the segment lock (`@GuardedBy("this")`), drains that queue to update the real LRU eviction ordering.

ANSWER: On a read, `LocalCache.Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` adds the accessed entry to the segment's `recencyQueue` (a lock-free `ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReferenceEntry<K,V>>`) without acquiring the segment lock; later, `LocalCache.Segment.drainRecencyQueue()` (called while holding the segment lock) drains that queue and applies the accesses to the real LRU eviction list.
